primitives.name: Defensive Sack Rate Projection
primitives.verbatim_quote: DST chart ("Last 8 Games"): **Projected Sack Rate = 67% × opponent offense sack rate + 33% × defense sack rate**, plotted against Vegas projected points, with "Sicko Defense" (high sack rate, low opponent total) and "Bad Defense" zones.
primitives.symbol_and_unit_ledger: {'S_{\\text{proj}}': 'Projected sack rate (dimensionless)', 'S_{\\text{opp}}': 'Opponent offensive sack rate (dimensionless)', 'S_{\\text{def}}': 'Defense sack rate (dimensionless)'}
primitives.assumptions: Linear combination of opponent and defense performance; static weights reflect historical consistency.
primitives.breakdown_regime: When opponent or defense data is missing or anomalous.

layer2.mapping: Used in GSE for DST scoring prediction via scatter plot regression; in GSI, applied to Bayesian posterior over projected points.
layer2.telemetry: Vegas projected points vs. actual sack rate deviation

primitives.name: Kicker Field Goal Efficiency
primitives.verbatim_quote: K chart: team implied total vs 2026 FG attempts/game, "Smash Spot" top-right, "Fade" bottom-left (Eagles @ WAS lowest); highest FG-attempt marks ~3.0/game (MIN @ DET, IND @ JAX); DAL vs ARI far right on projected points.
primitives.assumptions: Field goal success correlates with attempt frequency and opponent strength.
primitives.breakdown_regime: Inconsistent weather or injury affecting kicker performance.

layer2.mapping: GSE uses this for lineup risk assessment; GSI applies it to conditional probability of high-scoring K plays.
layer2.telemetry: Implied total vs. actual FGs made per game

primitives.name: Running Back EPA Accumulation
primitives.verbatim_quote: Cumulative Total EPA: McCaffrey +163.6 (119 games, rank #1 of 52 careers reaching that point); Taylor -28.3 (91 games, #47 of 120).
primitives.symbol_and_unit_ledger: {'EPA_{\\text{total}}^{\\text{RB}}': 'Total EPA for running back career (dimensionless)', 'EPA_i^{\\text{rush}}': 'EPA from rushing plays (dimensionless)', 'EPA_i^{\\text{rec}}': 'EPA from receiving plays (dimensionless)'}
primitives.assumptions: Career EPA accumulation is a valid measure of long-term value; includes both rushing and receiving contributions.
primitives.breakdown_regime: When RB changes teams or roles significantly altering EPA contribution types.

layer2.mapping: Maps to GSE’s dynamic lineup optimization; GSI uses it for player valuation and risk modeling.
layer2.telemetry: Career EPA ranking vs. current game performance

DST sack rate blending combines opponent and defense data into a single predictive variable, enabling GSE to model defensive impact on scoring. Kicker FG efficiency maps attempt volume to scoring potential, useful for GSI’s probabilistic forecasting. RB EPA accumulation provides a longitudinal view of player value, supporting both GSE’s state transitions and GSI’s Bayesian inference. Each primitive is grounded in measurable data and can be retroactively validated. Failure modes include data gaps, role changes, and external factors like injuries or weather. Dualities emerge between projected and realized performance, particularly in DST and K categories where variance is high. The system supports both deterministic and stochastic reasoning layers.
